# Fair Gacha, Pity & Collection Requirements Quality Checklist

**Purpose**: Đánh giá chất lượng, tính công bằng, độ minh bạch xác suất và tính toàn vẹn giao dịch cho hệ thống Gacha nội tệ và Bộ sưu tập (`009-gacha-collection`).
**Created**: 2026-11-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Fair Play, Ethics & Zero Real-Money Constraints

- [ ] CHK001 Is the `100%` in-game `STARLIGHT_SHARD` currency policy (`160` single / `1,600` 10-pull) with strict prohibition of real-money purchases and cash-out in MVP unambiguously specified? [Completeness, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-002, Constitution §VI]
- [ ] CHK002 Are anti-dark-pattern UX requirements (no artificial pressure timers, no hazardous flashing, skippable reveal animations, core game playable without gacha) clearly documented? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-010, Constitution §V & §VI]

## Probability Disclosure, Pity & Limited Banner Rules

- [ ] CHK003 Are exact probability invariants (`sum(baseRates) === 1.000000`, fail-fast boot validation, public display of all 6 rarities and current `pityCounter / hardPity`) unambiguously quantified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-003, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK004 Are Soft Pity, Hard Pity, internal top-tier split (`25% MYTHIC / 75% LEGENDARY`), lower-tier proportional scaling, and `10-pull EPIC+` guarantee specified consistently for both `bnr_perm_heroes` (`65 / 80`) and `bnr_perm_arsenal` (`55 / 70`)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK005 Are Limited Banner (`bnr_lim_*`) rules — specifically `sharedPityGroup` persistence across rotations and `50/50 Featured Guarantee` state transitions — completely specified without ambiguity? [Completeness, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-004]

## Duplicate Conversion, Star Essence Shop & Codex Quality

- [ ] CHK006 Are character duplicate conversion rules for both within-cap (`Constellation 0..6` + `STAR_ESSENCE`) and overflow beyond `C6` (double `STAR_ESSENCE` + `mat_starlight_dust`) explicitly enumerated for all 6 rarities? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK007 Are weapon duplicate rules (retaining the full weapon instance plus granting `STAR_ESSENCE` and `CRAFTING_TOKEN`) clearly specified without conflicting with inventory capacity constraints? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK008 Are `STAR_ESSENCE` exchange shop rules (`16` offers, UTC monthly `limitPerMonth` tracking, inventory pre-check, atomic deduction) and Hero/Weapon Collection Codex coverage completely specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-009]

## Atomicity, Concurrency, Auditability & Local JSON Storage

- [ ] CHK009 Do all persistence requirements mandate 100% local JSON storage (`characters/<id>.json`, `inventories/<id>.json`, `history/gacha-history-<id>.json`, `ledgers/currency-ledger-*.json`) via multi-file JSON WAL with zero external DBMS or third-party services? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-008, Constitution §I]
- [ ] CHK010 Are server-authoritative cryptographic RNG execution, concurrent-pull serialization (`20` parallel requests test criterion), and `>= 24h` idempotent replay semantics unambiguously specified? [Security, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-005, Spec §SC-002, Constitution §II]
- [ ] CHK011 Are paginated history retention fields (`pityBefore`, `pityAfter`, duplicate conversion detail, `rngAuditSeedHash`, server timestamp) completely defined for player transparency and auditing? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK012 Are edge cases (inactive/expired banners, invalid pull counts outside `{1, 10}`, full inventory pre-checks, crash recovery) and `proposed / unverified` latency labels explicitly documented? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §SC-004, Spec §SC-005, Constitution §VIII]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after human/lead review confirms each requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
